tagline: Trailers first. Then what to watch.
brief: A self-hosted movie and TV discovery service in the spirit of Apple Trailers: quickly play trailers, filter by genre, see what is coming soon and what just came out.
criteria: Success: reads as 'trailers' at a glance, adds a discovery idea, distinct from Plex/Jellyfin/Overseerr, works at 16 px and in one colour.

concepts.name: Play Sweep
concepts.idea: A play button sliced by radar arcs: trailers, scanned as they come.
rationale: The play triangle says 'trailers' before anything else
Two arcs sweep outward: discovery, what's coming next
Teal & orange, the Hollywood colour grade: cinematic, not another purple media server
Small-size cut with one arc keeps it crisp as a favicon

next_steps: Drop the web icon set into the app
Use the README lockup on GitHub
Run a trademark search before wider use
